import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Convert categorical variables to categorical type
data['brand'] = data['brand'].astype('category')
data['sensor_type'] = data['sensor_type'].astype('category')
data['lens_mount'] = data['lens_mount'].astype('category')
data['body_type'] = data['body_type'].astype('category')

# Create a countplot to visualize the distribution of brands
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='brand', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Camera Brands')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output1.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))

plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a barplot to visualize the distribution of sensor types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sensor_type', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Sensor Types')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.savefig('output4.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
